title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 282 (Directions of Tribunal on report of Company Liquidator)

content.overview: On consideration of the Company Liquidator's report under section 281, the Tribunal shall fix a time limit within which the entire proceedings shall be completed and the company dissolved; the Tribunal may revise the time limit and may order steps to protect, preserve or enhance the value of assets.
content.glance: Tribunal fixes (and may revise) a time limit for completion of winding-up after considering the liquidator's report; may order asset-protection steps.
content.study: Section 282 requires the Tribunal, after considering the section 281 report, to fix a time limit for completion of the winding-up and dissolution. The Tribunal may revise the limit at any stage after hearing the liquidator, creditors, contributories or other interested persons, and may order measures to protect, preserve or enhance asset value.

sections.heading: Time limit
sections.body: Tribunal fixes a time limit for completion of proceedings and dissolution after considering the liquidator's report.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.body: Tribunal may revise the time limit if continuation is not advantageous or economical, after hearing relevant parties.

sections.heading: Asset directions
sections.body: Tribunal may order steps to protect, preserve or enhance the value of the company's assets and pass other fitting orders.

provisions.title: Directions of Tribunal on report of Company Liquidator

examples.title: Fixed timeline
examples.body: After the s. 281 report the Tribunal sets a completion deadline; the liquidator must work within that framework subject to any revision.

hypotheticals.question: Can the Tribunal change the winding-up completion deadline?
hypotheticals.analysis: Yes. Under s. 282 the Tribunal may revise the time limit if it considers that continuing the proceedings is not advantageous or economical.

misconceptions.trap: The time limit fixed under s. 282 is immutable.
misconceptions.correction: Section 282 expressly allows revision after hearing the liquidator and interested persons.

questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State the rule of s. 282. II. Apply to facts. III. Conclude.
